profile.name: ACQ400数据采集机箱
profile.description: ACQ400是一类模块化高速数据采集机箱，用于在实验中采集、监测并流式保存模拟量或数字量信号。它通常集成多个采集站点或插槽，可通过EPICS过程变量进行状态监控、参数访问和连续数据记录，适用于物理实验、工程测试和装置诊断。
profile.description_en: The ACQ400 is a modular high-speed data acquisition chassis used in laboratories to acquire, monitor, and stream analog or digital signals to storage. It typically includes multiple acquisition sites or slots and is operated through EPICS process variables for status monitoring, parameter access, and continuous data recording in physics experiments, engineering tests, and system diagnostics.
